# Plainly
> Plainly is an independent information resource for Dubai property owners, publishing valuation,
> handover and short-let guidance. It is not a brokerage and does not advertise property.

Contact: [PHONE] · [EMAIL]

## What this site is
Advice, data and tools for people who already own — or are about to take handover of — property
in Dubai. It does not advertise individual properties.

## Key facts
- Service: property information and guidance; referral to RERA-licensed partners
- Area served: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Valuation turnaround: written report within 24 hours

## Important pages
- Property valuation: https://plainlyproperty.com/property-valuation-dubai/
- Golden visa valuation: https://plainlyproperty.com/property-valuation-dubai/golden-visa/
- Snagging and handover: https://plainlyproperty.com/snagging-dubai/
- Snagging costs: https://plainlyproperty.com/snagging-dubai/cost/
- Holiday home management: https://plainlyproperty.com/holiday-home-management-dubai/
- Short-let vs long-let: https://plainlyproperty.com/holiday-home-management-dubai/short-let-vs-long-let/
